rules.condition: The final fixed or dynamic Schedule 1 row contains invalid data.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: getTotalRow returns the final zero-based jQuery index; loops start at 1 and end at that index, omitting the actual final row.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Return the actual row count/highest row identifier and validate every extant row.

rules.condition: The final Schedule 1 row contains locally extracted tax due.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The same off-by-one excludes the final row from TotalExciseTaxDue.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Sum every extant row.

rules.condition: Imported tax due, adjustment, or total tax due differs from locally extracted Tax Due F.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: TotalExciseTaxDue sums only locally extracted Tax Due F, ignoring the schedule total column, imported tax due, and adjustments.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Derive Item 16 from the authoritative Total Tax Due column.

rules.condition: Entered tax-due values disagree with taxable/exempt/rate inputs.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The row tax computation function is entirely commented out; tax-due and total fields remain manual.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Compute each row from a revision-pinned legal rate table.

rules.condition: Day is two nonnumeric characters or year is four nonnumeric characters.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: isNaN(strmm || strdd || stryyyy) tests only the first truthy component; Invalid Date comparisons then fail open.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Strictly parse every component as digits.

rules.condition: The email contains a valid-looking address as a substring plus junk.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The regex is not anchored and accepts substring matches.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate the full normalized address.

rules.condition: A Validate-only location, relief, payment, balance, email, ZIP, or schedule rule fails.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Save checks only date, RDO, name, address, and contact.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a shared phase-aware validation graph.

rules.condition: A dynamic row index reaches 100 or more.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: getFieldRowNum reads only the last two ID characters, so three-digit row indices are truncated.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Store row identity as typed data rather than parsing the last two characters.
